convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'Ichimoku_Osc' custom indicator and depends on external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trade execution and smoothing algorithms, requiring manual replication of custom indicator and library logic

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation
UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal bar end
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar end

other_exits: Opposite signal triggers close of existing position: bearish oscillator crossover closes long, bullish crossover closes short

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. Input MM=0.1 is the fraction or lot depending on MMMode selection

custom_logic_notes: Entry requires two conditions: oscillator direction change (buffer[1] vs buffer[2]) confirms trend, then oscillator continuing in same direction (buffer[0] vs buffer[1]) confirms entry. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on bar index 1 (previous completed bar) with 3-bar copy window. Signal is recalculated only on new bars or when Recount flag is set due to CopyBuffer failure. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose input booleans act as master switches to enable/disable each direction. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose and GlobalVariableDel_ functions. SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides GetStartBars and smoothing enum definitions.
python_conversion_notes: Must replicate the Ichimoku_Osc custom indicator logic which smooths the Ichimoku oscillator value using JJMA (or user-selected method from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh). The smoothed oscillator is not a standard Ichimoku component - it is a proprietary derivation. Entry logic uses a 3-bar comparison: Value[2] > Value[1] (trend direction) AND Value[0] >= Value[1] (continuation confirmation) for longs, and inverse for shorts. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh money management has 5 modes (LOT, FREEMARGIN, BALANCE, LOSSFREEMARGIN, LOSSBALANCE) that must be reimplemented. Signal timestamps use SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + PeriodSeconds for trade timing. No digit adjustment is performed on SL/TP values - they are passed as-is to the trade library.
